verdict.rationale: Asaas's single API covers Brazilian local payment methods: Pix, boleto, credit and debit cards, and TED. Setting billingType to UNDEFINED lets the payer choose among the enabled methods on one payment page, so local methods from one integration are documented. The evidence never mentions digital wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), bank redirects or BNPL. Missing for 10: Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet support, bank-redirect methods, BNPL offerings, independent corroboration.
